decisions.reason: Turnaround management is central to the firm's data-driven, integrated airport operations strategy and has a dedicated web page.
Billing software is less central to operations but provides recurring revenue and ties airport customers into the software suite.
Equipment monitoring builds on the installed docking and apron hardware base and supports lucrative maintenance services.
Apron resource management complements turnaround software, though it could be merged into it as the suite consolidates after Product B's withdrawal.
Safety alert services for controllers fit the firm's tower expertise, are hard to replace once certified, and have long lifecycles.
